rationale.agent-scope-drift: Agents make hidden architectural decisions beyond deliberate human design.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Minute-scale scaffolding outpaces architectural audits requiring hours or days.
rationale.quality-debt: Prompt-driven infrastructure adds complexity, coupling, failure modes, and technical debt.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Proposed conformance layer checks dependency graphs against declared constraints.
rationale.risk-routing: Complexity thresholds would trigger architectural review for excessive scaffolding.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Plan-before-execution checkpoints give humans control over architectural decisions.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Impact statements expose infrastructure consequences for human architectural judgment.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Extracted reasoning traces persist architectural decisions and rationales as ADRs.
rationale.framework: Three reusable layers integrate constraints, conformance, and architectural knowledge.
rationale.design-only: The governance architecture is specified but neither implemented nor evaluated.
rationale.agentic: Agents generate complete projects and make artifact-scale architectural choices.
rationale.steering: Prompt features and context constraints substantively shape generated architectures.
rationale.risk-quality: Focal analysis covers complexity, coupling, maintainability, and technical debt.
rationale.method-experiment: Prompt variants are manipulated while agent and runtime model remain constant.
